description: This file contains unit tests for the Night Mode feature in the AnySoftKeyboard Android application. It tests various configurations and behaviors related to night mode settings, including system follow, always on, never, and user-controlled preferences, as well as integration with power saving mode.

classes.name: NightModeTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of night mode settings and their interaction with system configuration and power saving modes.

methods.name: testValuesArray
methods.description: Verifies the contents of the night mode values array and default value string.

methods.name: configurationForNightMode
methods.description: Creates a Configuration object with a specified night mode setting.

methods.name: testApplicationObservable
methods.description: Tests the application's observable for night mode changes based on configuration updates.

methods.name: testNeverNightMode
methods.description: Verifies that night mode remains off when set to 'never'.

methods.name: testAlwaysNightMode
methods.description: Verifies that night mode remains on when set to 'always'.

methods.name: testFollowSystemNightMode
methods.description: Verifies behavior when night mode follows the system setting.

methods.name: testControlledByEnabledPref
methods.description: Tests night mode behavior when controlled by a user preference toggle.

methods.name: testControlledByEnabledPrefDefaultFalse
methods.description: Tests power saving mode observable when default preference is false and battery state changes.

methods.name: testWhenLowPowerSavingModeWithDevicePowerSavingState
methods.description: Tests the interaction between device power saving mode and the app's power saving observable.

methods.name: sendBatteryState
methods.description: Simulates a battery low or okay broadcast.

methods.name: sendPowerSavingState
methods.description: Simulates a change in device power saving mode.
